critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/quotes.py _mp_engine_payload L666-694: divide-by-active-pcs is gated correctly on (quoteType==Multi-Part AND pricingMode==Matched Set AND valid active index) — Individual and Simple modes are provably untouched. Idempotent because it operates on the current stored top qtys which the frontend already anchors as setQty*activePcs. Good.

backend/routes/engine_routes.py calculate_multi_part L580-581: Matched Set path re-multiplies set_qty by each component's pcsPerSet — this is the ONLY place per-component pcs multiplication happens in Matched Set mode, so as long as payload.qtys is the raw set qty, results are stable regardless of active tab. Fix is architecturally sound.

frontend switchBomItem re-scaling top qtys to setQty*newItemPcsPerSet is what makes the UI's visible qty0 change between hutch(2) and shelf(6) tabs — this could confuse users who expect the visible qty to always represent 'kits'. Consider adding a small helper caption '2 sets · 6 shelves total' near input-qty-0 in Matched Set mode so estimators aren't surprised.

mpSchema.healLoadedState correctly normalized this real corrupt draft (activeIdx=2 shelf) into the canonical shape — verified in mongo. Recommend the same heal run on backend GET as a defensive net for any drafts saved by an older client build that hasn't picked up the frontend fix yet.

rca of the issue: Root cause was the legacy pre-multiplication convention (state.qtys already scaled by pcsPerSet) colliding with the cloud engine's Matched Set path which independently multiplies set qty by pcsPerSet. When switchBomItem swapped top-level state.qtys to the active component's pre-multiplied qtys, the engine received a shelf's 6 as the 'set qty' and inflated the kit total 3×. Fix chain: (A) buildMpPayload divides by activePcs before sending → engine gets raw set qty. (B) _mp_engine_payload does the same on the server (report/analysis parity). (C) switchBomItem re-anchors top qtys as setQty*newPcsPerSet so the UI shows the right visible qty per tab. (D) healLoadedState normalizes corrupt drafts on load. All 4 legs verified working end-to-end with real Balconi data.
